Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Jitendra Kumar Bharti  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ajay Mishra  Mr.Arvind Kumar  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 19-09-2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence under Sections 420, 467,
468, 471 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The petitioner is alleged to have obtained appointment, as Panchayat Teacher, on the basis of forged and fabricated certificate.

4. It is submitted on behalf of petitioner that petitioner was appointed, as Panchayat Teacher, after investigation of all his educational certificates by the concerned department, but later on, same has been declared as forged and fabricated without proper verification or giving any notice to the petitioner.
Moreover, petitioner has already sent his resignation from Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.51801 of 2023(3) dt.19-09-2023 service through speed post to the Panchayat Secretary, Basuari,
. Copy of letter of resignation alongwith speed post receipt is annexed as Annexure 2 to the supplementary affidavit.

sentences.text:
Learned A.P.P. for the State and learned counsel for the Vigilance Department opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of petitioner.
6.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the above named petitioner, in the event of his arrest/surrender before the court below within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M. - I, Jhanjharpur, District - Madhubani in connection with Ghoghardiha P.S. Case No. 96 of 2022, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) anay/-
